foundation.name: Synthetic Client Checklist

desiredOutcome.value: See missing material at a glance

constraints: Use local JavaScript with no dependencies
Synthetic data only; no deployment or messages
unknowns: Who buys this and how often delays matter

proposal.title: See which client files are missing
proposal.journey: Enter required and received items, then read what is missing.
proposal.criticalUnknown: Does seeing missing items reduce chasing?
proposal.why: A local example tests clarity before accounts or reminders.
proposal.nextAction: Build a local checklist from synthetic required and received items.
capabilities: Accept required and received item lists
technicalAcceptance: Missing items are shown in required order
Matching trims whitespace and ignores letter case
Input arrays stay unchanged; malformed inputs fail
learningAcceptance: Later observe whether an agency worker can identify the next file to request without help
proposal.observationWindow: After a synthetic demo, arrange real observation separately

intention.statement: I want a profitable solo business.

consequence.value: Delays may consume time that could be spent on paid work

brief.summary: You want a profitable solo business helping agencies collect client files. Project managers and email workarounds are assumptions; the buyer and pain frequency remain unknown.
